column1: # The names and four-letter keys of the AWS accounts: the single source of truth.
# name         explanatory: account name, and where it is also an environment, the
#              live/environments/<name> stack, GitHub Environment and APP_ENV, and docs.
# ou           the organizational unit the account lives in (Management, Development,
#              Environments, Operations). The accounts of the Environments OU are the deployable
#              environments and are the only ones with a live/environments/<name> stack.
# key          exactly four lowercase letters (^[a-z]{4}$) and unique. Used in the naming
#              conventions of AWS resources (role names, policy and resource name patterns) so that
#              they can be checked with strict regexps. A key is not a name: it is never accepted
# description  a short sentence, for people.
# Fields are separated by a tab. scripts/ci-stacks.sh validates this file on every run and the
# selftest (scripts/test-tooling.sh) proves that a bad key, a duplicate or an unknown OU is refused.
